does: Loads the translated texts of one language folder under Localization; BaseApp::Start calls it once for English (second argument true) when the language is another, then for the language, right after ls::PackedFileManager::LoadPackFiles and before App::InitApp.

The macOS build's symbols hold this name; a stored pair of the two builds joins that function to this one (a seed)
CoreLib.dll exports this name; the symbol database matches the export to this function by strings
